subject: [PATCH v5 7/7] mm/memcontrol: add stock to the memsw page_counter

2026-08-31.patch_summary: This patch adds a separate stock to the memsw page_counter in Linux's memory control system. This change allows memsw (memory swap) to benefit from caching charges, which were previously only applied to memory. The patch also updates various functions to handle the new stock correctly, including allocation and freeing of stocks, charging and uncharging of pages, and handling of hotplug CPU events. As a result, the patch reduces the skew between memory and memsw charges, but still allows for transient drifts due to per-cpu stocks.
